title: Kali Hub Anti Ragdoll Kill Aura Speed Boost Auto Skills
features:
Kali Hub is the first Choose Your Power script publicly available to everyone.

Works on any executor except Solara or Xeno; may not work on Velocity. Supports both PC and Mobile.

[Combat Tab]

[+] Custom Kill Aura Delay
[+] Custom Kill Aura Max Distance
[+] Custom Kill Aura Hit Chance
[+] Custom Kill Aura Animation Speed
[+] Custom Kill Aura Facing Angle
[+] (Optional) Kill Aura Require Facing
- Kill Aura
- Anti Ragdoll
- Infinite Jump
[+] Custom Speed Boost Amount (Legit & Blatant Presets)
- Speed Boost

[Auto Skill Tab]

[+] Custom Skill Range
[+] Custom Rotation Speed
[+] Custom Skill Cooldown
[+] Custom Field of View
[+] Custom Skills Key
[+] (Optional) Predict Movement
[+] (Optional) Only Use Skill When Facing
[+] Custom Target Indicator Color
[+] (Optional) Target Indicator
- Auto Skills

[ESP Players Tab]

[+] (Optional) ESP Names
[+] (Optional) ESP Distance

[+] Custom Text Size
